style: 黑暗童话木屋，低顶、生活家具组合和吊挂装饰

rules.title: 低顶室内
rules.scatter_rule: 梁架先验净空；壁炉与柴薪、缝纫台与布篓成组；低家具不放大道路边界。
rules.junction_rule: 低顶所有出口先并集三角化，只生成一张顶；拱架脚点避开全部道路，路口停止重复整框。
rules.top_rule: 连续平顶使用世界材质相位；不新增左右墙。挂物必须绑定真实顶面socket。

ground.source: design_initial; measure runtime slope before acceptance

lighting.diagnostic: freeze exact camera and simulation; white ambient; fog/virtual lights disabled; bright background
lighting.acceptance: Diagnostic gaps are observations. Accept matched dark background/sky/fog joins when production lighting and supported light changes remain convincing; require local geometry for visibly lit gaps.

examples: plain beam frame, repaired frame, asymmetric beam frame
lantern+chain; dried herbs+cord; draped cloth+paired hooks
kit.root_policy: Furniture needs authored support points. Hanging fixtures use top sockets and lowest points, never bottom-center roots. A figure hanging by a rope is an explicit optional narrative asset, not randomly selected room dressing.
kit.assembly: One continuous ceiling mesh across all exits. Beam supports must clear every path after scale. Hanging chain+body use one pivot; doorway frame is decoration, never proof of closure.
kit.light_fx: Default hanging sway zero, optional <=2 degrees, <=8 moving fixtures. No physics chain, no per-fixture real light. Static soft ceiling material; no floor dirt texture reused as final ceiling.
kit.junction: Single roof polygon union with continuous UV. Do not add left/right walls. Before a fork, preserve all exits; do not remove unselected roof while still visible.
kit.dimension_rule: Derive ceiling width from locked camera rays, not corridor width. Existing candidate upper-30-percent bound is insufficient for full camera-sweep acceptance.
kit.lighting_acceptance: Choose open/atmospheric/hybrid/geometric. Compare diagnostic with production lighting and actual permitted changes before deciding roof asset scope.
